summary: A bird makes a nest where it can brood over its eggs or young. In the instructions for building the ark, the plural of the noun describes its compartments.

senses.definition: The place where a bird lays its eggs or shelters its young.

evidence.note: The nest may be in a tree or on the ground, with the mother sitting over the young or the eggs.

senses.definition: One of the separate spaces built into the ark.

evidence.note: After specifying the wood, the instruction says קִנִּים תַּעֲשֶׂה אֶת הַתֵּבָה, directing Noah to make the ark with compartments.

senses.definition: Of a bird, to establish its nesting place.

evidence.note: Birds nest in the trees, and the next line identifies the trees where the stork makes its home.
